quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other vehicles go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other vehicles pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other vehicles pass if needed.
questions.explanation: A triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you reach the intersection. Be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicycles, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. In this case, it curves left. You may see several of these signs placed along the curve.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is stretched straight out to the left, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn left.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on a green light must let oncoming traffic pass first.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for hazards ahead. They are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns of a sharp turn coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows you the only direction traffic can flow.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is ahead. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows which direction traffic must travel on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines are double in work zones.

questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for hazards ahead. They are yellow with black symbols. This sign warns you that the road ahead has low overhead clearance.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means a traffic light is coming. Be ready to stop or slow down.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, what does it mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals when they don't have turn signals. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing up means the rider will turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road will curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
Specific turns are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes must merge smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is for vehicles with a certain number of people inside.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. HOV lanes are only for buses and vehicles with the required number of passengers shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is coming. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black symbols. They alert you to hazards or special situations ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest speed you may drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights from bottom to top are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.
There are trucks on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black symbols. This sign alerts you that an intersection is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means right turns are not allowed. Do not turn right at this location.

questions.question: What can you do in a center turn lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is coming. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you to slow down because the road may be slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if cars are coming toward you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the other road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a full stop. Let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a railroad crossing at a steep angle. Low vehicles may scrape or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns you of a steep hill ahead. Adjust your speed to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right lane ends or road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends or road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be in the area ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay on the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When an operator bends their left arm at the elbow and points it downward, it means they plan to slow down or stop. Hand signals are used instead of or along with turn signals.

questions.question: This sign prevents:

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: This sign tells you that:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a winding road ahead with three or more curves.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction and maintenance signs warn drivers about unusual or dangerous conditions in work areas. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic is entering from the right side.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic speed and movement. You must obey the rules on these signs. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign tells you that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. Drive to the right of it.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey all rules on these signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign tells you a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control how traffic moves and must be obeyed. This sign means you cannot park here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that wet roads can be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow and black and prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions. This sign tells you a lane is ending and you should prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: On a road with two or more lanes, make room for vehicles entering from other lanes. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs warn of railroad crossings. This sign tells you a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
Your road crosses a divided highway.
You are driving over a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road crosses a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two separate one-way roads with a median or barrier between them.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Turn right only after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign that shows laws you must obey. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must yield to pedestrians in crosswalks. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you must either turn right or go straight.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a Y intersection is ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking along the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully where pedestrians may be present.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they cannot turn left. It is a regulation sign that drivers must obey.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You can either continue through or exit the freeway from your lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane ends at an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit if you stay in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road intersection is ahead with another road joining from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that people are crossing the road here. Watch for people in the crosswalk and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the bridge or overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Yield the right-of-way and proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this green arrow on a lane use control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many turns and curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic from the side.

questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic from the side.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead. Be ready for traffic crossing your path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. U-turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not permitted at this location.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down and swings it down to their side, it signals the group to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that traffic may come from the opposite direction ahead.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit sign show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good weather and road conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good weather and road conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road in ideal conditions. You may need to drive slower if weather or road conditions are poor.

questions.question: What does a sign with this shape and color indicate?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign is used only to warn of a no passing zone.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does the lead rider signal when they raise their left arm with their index finger pointing up?

options.text: The group will exit at the next exit.

questions.explanation: The lead rider raising their left arm with one finger pointing up signals the group to ride in a single-file formation.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a railroad crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers that:

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane will end soon. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers to a steep downhill road ahead. Slow down and avoid damaging your brakes or causing a collision.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is on top and green is on bottom. On a horizontal light, red is on the left and green is on the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that the divided highway is ending soon.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be prepared to stop and give the right-of-way to other vehicles and pedestrians. Come to a full stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
A divided highway starts. Slow to the safe speed shown.
Merge ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
The road winds ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow to the safe speed shown.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right. Reduce your speed to the safe speed shown (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Two lanes of opposite traffic are merging.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails are ahead and to the right.
A hotel is ahead and to the right.
A hospital is ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A hospital is ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in groups, the lead rider uses hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with the palm up and swings their arm upward, it means all riders should go faster.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead only allows one-way traffic.
The bridge ahead can only fit one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the bridge ahead is narrow. Be careful because you may not have enough space to pass a truck on this bridge.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: You can use hand signals instead of or in addition to turn signals. If your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing up, it means you plan to turn right or move to the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let that traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and check for vehicles or pedestrians before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming in both directions ahead.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a T intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals to show turns or stops. An arm extended straight out to the left means the rider will turn left or move left.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles often cross or ride next to traffic here.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: When you see this sign, you must:

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic
Stop completely and wait for a green light
Slow down and check for traffic

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for people and other cars. Wait for the intersection to clear before you go.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: The road curves only to the right
The road turns sharply to the right
The road curves right and then left
The road curves left and then right

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right and then left
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may be out of alignment
You could hydroplane if water is on the shoulder
You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if you drift onto the shoulder
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or respond to cross traffic.

questions.question: In group riding, what does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders should stop.

questions.question: What does this signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal tells other riders to follow you.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to upcoming road conditions. This sign warns you that the road ahead has curves. Slow down and be prepared.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction will soon become one lane. Be prepared to merge.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming up. Prepare to stop completely before you go forward.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area. Follow their directions.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers turning left on a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You may complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Be ready for traffic joining the road.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Give the right-of-way to pedestrians and other vehicles. Stop only if necessary.
